descriptions.w3d_push_heap_8034a400: STLport push_heap for {handle, priority} entries: moves the last entry up while its parent compares lower (priority, then object name).
descriptions.w3d_adjust_heap_8034a568: STLport __adjust_heap for {handle, priority} entries ordered by priority, then by the handles' object names.
descriptions.w3d_pop_heap_8034a7fc: STLport pop_heap for {handle, priority} entries: moves the top entry to the end and re-heaps the rest.
